newsitem.title: UK: UK's FTSE ends weaker as BT merger fails to excite.
newsitem.headline: UK's FTSE ends weaker as BT merger fails to excite.

text.p: The UK stock market shed half a percent on Monday as political worries and weak futures prices trampled enthusiasm about the multi-billion pound merger between British Telecom and MCI Communications.
The FTSE 100 index of leading shares rose as high as 3,956.2 points in early trade as BT and other telecom shares soared on the MCI merger, the biggest trans-Atlantic deal in history.

But weak FTSE futures prices, worries about a possible Democrat sweep at U.S. elections on Tuesday and the increasingly uncertain British political landscape knocked the gloss off the market and the FTSE 100 closed 20.4 points lower at 3,928.1.
